selection_objective: Validation balanced accuracy; ties minimize false-positive rate.

signal_definitions.dense: maximum cosine similarity among the top-5 dense results
signal_definitions.bm25: maximum BM25 score among the top-5 BM25 results
signal_definitions.hybrid: maximum dense cosine similarity among the top-5 RRF results; RRF score itself is not treated as confidence

provisional_reason: Only eight approved validation questions (six answerable and two unanswerable) were used.
note: Fresh results are saved separately under reports/public_release; they do not change the application's default calibration path.
